content.value: For a single server queuing model with Poisson arrival and exponential service and with 25 unlimited queue, deduce the formula for;
(i) Mean number of units in system
(ii) Mean waiting time in queue under steady state condition.

Thus find the values of service rate of 6 units/hour and arrival rate of 4 units/hours.   
Define the symbols you used.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2018
